The vision
A personal project / a long-term dream

Something worth building.

Some dreams take time. This is a personal project I'm slowly working toward — one idea, one step and one day at a time.

Support the project  ↗
The idea

A place for everyone.

The idea is bigger than one person. I want to create something that can be experienced, remembered and shared — a beautiful public place surrounded by nature, history and open space.

The project is about creating a destination people could actually visit: walk through the park, discover its details, learn something new and simply enjoy being there.

“A dream becomes more meaningful when it can be shared.”
Why share it?

Some dreams are meant to be shared.

I know this is a very ambitious idea. It may take many years, and there is no promise that every part of it will become reality. But a dream does not have to be finished to be worth sharing.

The purpose of this website is simple: to put the vision into words, develop the ideas, meet people who find them interesting and, step by step, discover what might be possible.

“You don't have to believe in the whole dream. Maybe one small part of it is enough.”
A second ambition

A ship remembered by the world.

I also have a dream that reaches beyond land: to recreate Titanic as a historically inspired, modern vessel and, one day, follow the same Atlantic route that made the original voyage part of history.

The goal would be to preserve the atmosphere and story while using modern engineering, navigation, safety systems and responsible maritime standards.

“History is worth remembering — and sometimes worth bringing back to life.”
An artistic illustration of Titanic — a symbol of the second ambition.

Questions

A few things worth knowing.

What is this?

A personal project and a long-term dream.

Do I have to support it?

No. Visiting, sharing or simply taking a look is already appreciated.

Where does support go?

Support is intended to help move this personal project forward. The description here should be kept accurate and updated as the project develops.

Is this an established project already?

No. This website represents an independent personal vision at an early stage. It is not a claim that a construction, shipbuilding or investment project has already been established.
